security_spec.violation_condition: XiangShan RTL vector load/store unit executes vle8.v with sign-extension of the loaded 8-bit value (sext to VLEN) when the updated spec mandates zero-extension (the sext was removed: read_memory<8> without sext). Additionally, if the RTL's vector LSU does not gate misaligned unit-stride accesses on VECTOR_LS_MISALIGNED_LEGAL, misaligned addresses silently proceed instead of raising an address-misaligned exception. If vm==0 mask support is absent (spec marks it TODO/unpredictable), masked-off elements may be overwritten instead of retaining undisturbed values.
security_spec.summary: vle8.v spec changed from sign-extended to zero-extended 8-bit loads and all unit-stride LS ops now require misaligned-access gating and vm mask support; incorrect RTL matching of these semantics causes silent data corruption on vector memory accesses
